title: DL101 The Representation Capability of Neural Network Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.24980v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Universal approximation theorems (Cybenko, Funahashi, Hornik & Leshno) provide the mathematical justification for why neural networks are powerful enough to model complex, nonlinear phenomena. Shallow networks can approximate any continuous function on compact sets. Leshno's theorem clarified that non-polynomial activations are necessary for universality, which explains why ReLU, logistic, hyperbolic tangent, and other common activations work (but pure polynomials do not).   However, approximation theorems provide no efficiency, training, nor generalization guarantees. They do not indicate how many neurons are needed for a given accuracy, whether gradient descent will find the right parameters, or whether networks trained on finite data will generalize well. translated_title: DL101：神经网络模型的表示能力
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.24980v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：通用近似定理（Cybenko、Funahashi、Hornik 与 Leshno）为神经网络为何足够强大、能够建模复杂非线性现象提供了数学依据。浅层网络可以逼近紧集上的任意连续函数。Leshno 定理阐明了非多项式激活函数对于实现通用性是必要的，这解释了为什么 ReLU、逻辑斯蒂（sigmoid）、双曲正切以及其他常见激活函数是有效的（而纯多项式激活则不行）。然而，逼近定理并未提供效率、训练或泛化方面的任何保证。它们既没有说明为达到给定精度需要多少神经元，也没有说明梯度下降能否找到正确的参数，或者在有限数据上训练的网络是否能够良好地泛化。Barron 为特定函数类提供了定量的误差界（即对傅里叶范数有界的函数给出了逼近速率），而 Montúfar 则是第一个证明……（摘要到此截断）
tldr: 本文系统梳理了通用近似定理这一神经网络表示能力的数学基石，指出非多项式激活函数是实现通用逼近的必要条件，并强调这些定理本身并不提供关于效率、训练收敛与泛化能力的保证。
en_tdlr: This paper reviews universal approximation theorems as the mathematical foundation of neural networks' representation capability, clarifying that non-polynomial activations are necessary for universality while emphasizing that these theorems alone provide no guarantees on efficiency, training, or generalization.
